'''Kushiukanushi no Mikoto''' (久志宇賀主命) was an ancient Japanese noble and an ancestor of the {{ill|Nakatomi clan|en|Nakatomi clan|qid=Q1198447|lt=Nakatomi clan}}.

== Overview ==
In the *{{ill|Nihon Shoki|en|Nihon Shoki|qid=Q813935|lt=Nihon Shoki}}*, during the reign of {{ill|Emperor Suinin|en|Emperor Suinin|qid=Q314850|lt=Emperor Suinin}}, an entry in the 26th year of the emperor’s reign notes that the emperor consulted Kushiukanushi no Mikoto (referred to as the ancestor of the Nakatomi clan) about whom should conduct the worship of {{ill|Yamato Okunitama|en|Yamato Okunitama|qid=Q11387080|lt=Ōyamato no Ōkami}}. The divination revealed that {{ill|Nunaki-iri-hime|ja|渟名城入姫命|lt=Nunakiiri-hime no Mikoto}} was the most suitable for this role.

== Genealogy ==
Kushiukanushi no Mikoto is identified as the son of {{ill|Kamikikikatsu|ja|神聞勝命|qid=Q106106971}} and the father of {{ill|Kuninazu no Ōkashima no Mikoto|ja|国摩大鹿島命}} according to genealogical records.<ref>『{{ill|Sonpi Bunmyaku|en|Sonpi Bunmyaku|qid=Q1704738|lt=Sonpi Bunmyaku}}』</ref>
